hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_file_path"; if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then cd /Volumes/External/rwxproject/agent-framework && uv run ruff format "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_file_path"; if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then cd /Volumes/External/rwxproject/agent-framework/ui && bunx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_command"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/|DROP\s+DATABASE|:\(\)\{:|--force.*main|push.*--force'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Potentially dangerous command detected' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
